priceHint: Free text, up to 120 characters. Leave empty if you do not want to state a price.
attendeeVisibility: Who can see the attendee list
attendeeVisibilityHint: The number of attendees is always public. This setting covers the names.
repeatDaysHint: The weekday of the first date is always included.
repeatLimit: A series has 2 to {max} dates, all at the same local time. Dates are created when you save.
previewTitle: {count, plural, one {# date} other {# dates}} — the first ones:
previewZone: Times are shown in the city's time zone: {zone}
previewMore: {count, plural, one {…and # more date} other {…and # more dates}}
lifecycle_DRAFT: Draft: only you and your co-organizers can see this event.
lifecycle_PUBLISHED: Published: the event is visible to everyone and open for RSVP.
lifecycle_CANCELLED: Cancelled: the page stays online and says that the event is cancelled.
cancelledDone: The event is cancelled. Everyone who RSVP'd has been notified.
cancelHint: Cancelling notifies everyone who answered “going” or “interested”, in the app and by email.
unpublished: The event is a draft again.
deleteConfirm: Delete this event for good? Its dates, team, invitations and RSVPs are removed. This cannot be undone.
createNext: After saving you can invite co-organizers, add artists and cancel single dates.
createdNext: Event saved. Below you can invite co-organizers, add artists and manage single dates.
hiddenNotice: This event has been hidden by moderators and is not visible to the public.
teamOwnerOnly: Only the owner can invite or remove co-organizers.
inviteWho: Username or email of the new co-organizer
inviteHint: They receive a link that is valid for 14 days and must accept it while signed in.
artistHandleHint: For teachers, DJs, bands or schools that already have a profile.
stubName: Or the name of an artist without a profile
stubHint: A public profile without an owner is created. The artist can claim it later.
singleDatesHint: Cancel or move one date without touching the rest of the series. People who RSVP'd are notified.
dateCancelled: The date is cancelled. Everyone who RSVP'd has been notified.
dateCancelledText: This date has been cancelled. The other dates of the series are not affected.
noAttendees: Nobody has answered yet. Be the first.
attendeesHidden_ATTENDEES: The list is visible to people who RSVP'd. Answer “going” or “interested” to see it.
attendeesHidden_ORGANIZERS: The organizers keep the attendee list private.
attendeesNote_ATTENDEES: Only people who RSVP'd and the organizers can see this list.
attendeesNote_ORGANIZERS: Only the organizers can see this list.
copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the link and copy it manually.
inviteSignIn: Sign in to see and answer this invitation.
inviteSignInHint: After signing in, open the link from your email again.
inviteVerifyEmail: Confirm your email address first, then open this link again.
inviteRights: Co-organizers can edit the event, publish or cancel it, manage single dates and artists, and see the attendee list. Only the owner can delete the event or change the team.
mailInviteBody:
{inviter} invites you to co-organize “{title}”.

Open the link below, sign in and accept or decline. The link is valid for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} and works only for your account.
mailCancelledBody:
“{title}” has been cancelled by the organizers.

It was planned for {date}.
mailDateCancelledBody:
One date of “{title}” has been cancelled: {date}.

The other dates of the series are not affected.
mailFooter: You receive this message because of your activity on Dance Community. Event emails can be switched off in your notification settings.
error_TOO_MANY_DATES: This series would have too many dates. Choose an earlier last day or fewer weekdays (52 dates at most).
error_INVALID_VENUE: Choose a venue from the selected city.
error_PROFILE_NOT_FOUND: No profile with that username was found.
error_ALREADY_MEMBER: This person is already an organizer of the event.
error_INVITE_LIMIT: Too many pending invitations. Revoke one or wait until it is answered.
error_INVITE_INVALID: This invitation is no longer valid. It may have expired, been revoked or already been used.
error_INVITE_MISMATCH: This invitation was sent to a different account. Sign in with the account it was addressed to.
error_ARTIST_LIMIT: An event can have up to 30 artists.
mediaOnPage: Photos and Instagram links are managed in the gallery on the event page.
onBehalfOfHint: Choose a school to add the event to its timetable. Everyone who manages the school can then edit it.
rsvpSeriesHint: This answer applies to every date unless you answer differently for a single date.
rsvpThisDateHint: An answer for this date replaces your answer for the series on this date only. Pick another date in the list above to answer for it.
answer_GOING: On this date you are going.
answer_INTERESTED: On this date you are interested.
answer_DECLINED: On this date you are not coming.
answer_NONE: You have not answered for this date yet.
answerFromDate: This is your answer for this date only.
answerFromSeries: This comes from your answer for the whole series.
dateAnswerSaved: Your answer for this date is saved.
dateAnswerCleared: Your answer for the series applies to this date again.
dateMovedText: This date has been rescheduled. It was originally planned for {date}.
moveDateHint: New time for {date}, in the event’s time zone ({zone}). The other dates stay as they are; people who answered for this date are notified.
dateMoved: The date is moved. Everyone who answered for it has been notified.
error_NOT_A_SERIES: This is a single event: it has no separate dates. Edit the event itself instead.
error_DATE_UNAVAILABLE: This date cannot be moved: it has already started or is cancelled. Restore a cancelled date first.
error_DATE_TAKEN: The series already has a date at that time. Choose another time.
error_PIN_TOO_FAR: The point is too far from the chosen city.
